Lucas' real accomplishment was the development of computer-controlled cameras. This is what allowed him to film the (at the time) ground-breaking traveling matte action sequences. Prior to SW, traveling matte shots required a stationary camera so the various image layers could be aligned. Adding a computer-controlled servo to the camera mount allowed the operator to precisely reproduce tracking and panning shots. It enabled TIE fighters to zoom past the camera as it panned across the top of the Millennium Falcon. This tech innovation is what Lucas won an Academy Award for, not his artistic abilities.
